summary.text: A dead aperture is an aperture that has died with the immortal zombie state. It no longer produces primeval or immortal essence, cannot be managed as a living blessed land, and changes what pressure and storage it can endure.

claims.text: After Fang Yuan turns into a zombie, his immortal aperture is a dead aperture, so he cannot treat it as a living blessed land he could swallow or rely on in place of Hu Immortal blessed land. His first aperture is dead silence, dry, and unable to produce primeval essence. The rock-like wall can handle more Immortal Gu pressure than a living rank five peak stage aperture would, though it still has a limit. The strength path immortal aperture has also turned grey as a dead land.

Because Fang Yuan became a zombie, his first aperture turned into a dead aperture and can hold on under Spring Autumn Cicada’s recovery. If the aperture were still living, it might already have burst. Even dead, it has a time limit before it cannot endure.

His immortal aperture has turned into a dead aperture. Whatever he places there dies. It cannot be managed or developed like a normal blessed land, cannot ease feeding Immortal Gu, and cannot produce immortal essence, which puts a heavier burden on immortal essence stones. With the immortal aperture already dead, cultivation stagnates until the immortal zombie body is shed.
Seven Star Child absorbed a fragment of blue heaven in the past, which lets Starry Sky grotto-heaven exist to this day and not become a dead aperture despite his state.
The immortal zombie cultivation state is covered on Immortal Zombie. Living immortal apertures are covered on Immortal Aperture.
